source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The removed assertion's success condition was that the item's calendar differed from the composite. The explicit failure branch must therefore test calendar == this. The owned and accepted methods use that condition, reject a missing calendar and otherwise return the concrete calendar's modify/delete operation. Review caught the intermediate opposite guard. This is the local delegation contract, with no reproduced recursion or runtime result.
title: Composite Calendar's explicit failure guard rejects self delegation
